days.message: Hazmat signage tells you what's inside. Read it.

days.title: Check The Gauge
days.message: Check pressure gauges before operating vessels.

days.title: No Blame Culture
days.message: We investigate to prevent, not to blame.

days.title: Track To Completion
days.message: Track every corrective action to completion.

days.title: Protect Your Joints
days.message: Kneeling often? Use knee pads.

days.title: Check It Works
days.message: Report any emergency light that isn't working.

days.title: Schedule It
days.message: Keep switchgear maintenance on schedule.

days.title: Get Certified
days.message: Only trained staff should handle hazardous chemicals.

days.title: Follow The Sequence
days.message: Follow the correct startup sequence every time.

days.title: Keep The Record
days.message: Document safety observations clearly and promptly.

days.title: Mark The Dates
days.message: Mark compliance deadlines on your calendar.

days.title: Support Your Spine
days.message: Heavy lifting? Wear your back support belt.

days.title: Know Who To Call
days.message: Know your fire safety officer's contact.

days.title: Don't Ignore It
days.message: Sparking equipment needs immediate reporting.

days.title: Know The Steps
days.message: Know your decontamination steps before an exposure happens.

days.title: Red Tag Faulty Equipment
days.message: Tag faulty equipment red. Don't use it.

days.title: Don't Sit On It
days.message: Escalate unresolved safety concerns without delay.

days.title: Review Regularly
days.message: Review compliance status with management regularly.

days.title: Learn To Use It
days.message: PPE only works if you use it right. Get trained.

days.title: Don't Block Them
days.message: Never stack material near sprinkler heads.

days.title: Right Glove, Right Job
days.message: Different chemicals need different gloves. Check the chart.

days.title: Know Where They Are
days.message: Know where the nearest fire blanket is kept.

days.title: Filter The Air
days.message: Dusty area? Wear your dust mask correctly.

days.title: Prevent Ignition
days.message: Static sparks can ignite flammable vapors. Ground your equipment.

days.title: Know The Difference
days.message: Splash risk needs goggles, not just glasses.

days.title: Take Them Seriously
days.message: A mock drill today prevents panic tomorrow.

days.title: Extra Ear Protection
days.message: Very loud area? Use ear muffs, not just plugs.

days.title: Refresh Your Knowledge
days.message: Use fire safety week to refresh your knowledge.

days.title: No Exceptions
days.message: PPE rules apply to everyone, every time.

days.title: Keep It Clear
days.message: Keep 3 feet clear in front of electrical panels.

days.title: Guests Need Gear Too
days.message: Visitors on the floor need PPE too.

days.title: Store Upright
days.message: Store gas cylinders upright and secured.

days.title: Know The Code
days.message: Different vest colors mean different roles. Learn them.

days.title: Spot The Hazard
days.message: Spot fire hazards before they become incidents.

days.title: Night Shift Safety
days.message: Night shift? Wear reflective gear near traffic.

days.title: Know The Basics
days.message: Know basic burn first aid before you need it.

days.title: It's Yours, Own It
days.message: Your PPE is yours. Keep it, care for it.

days.title: Everyone's Job
days.message: Fire safety isn't one person's job. It's everyone's.
